gbifID.description: Unique GBIF occurrence identifier assigned by the Global Biodiversity Information Facility.

datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking all records to the same occurrence dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each occurrence.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each record, consistently Animalia.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the organism, consistently Insecta.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Lepidoptera.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the recorded moth is Geometridae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded moth species, consistently Prasinocyma.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded moth species, constant across all records.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Taxonomic subspecies identifier missing for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each occurrence, uniformly recorded as SPECIES.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded moth species, Prasinocyma semicrocea (Walker, 1861).

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded Prasinocyma semicrocea specimen.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Original authorship citation for the scientific name, as recorded in source data.

countryCode.description: Country code for Australia (AU) for each occurrence record.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Australian state or territory where each occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status confirming species was observed at the recorded location.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed specimens, currently unavailable in this dataset.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record, expressed as a UUID.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude of occurrence point in decimal degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of observation in decimal degrees, ranging from approximately 115 to 153.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision information is unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Altitude of observation site in meters.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Accuracy of recorded depth values, usually measured in meters, currently missing.

eventDate.description: Date and time of each occurrence observation.

day.description: Day of month when observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for Prasinocyma semicrocea occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for each Prasinocyma semicrocea occurrence record.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, uniformly indicating observations made by humans.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for the observation, consistently recorded as iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All records share the same collection code, denoting observation entries.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each specimen record.

recordNumber.description: No values recorded in this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals or groups who recorded each Prasinocyma semicrocea occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the occurrence was identified, recorded as a UTC timestamp.

license.description: License type governing data reuse, expressed as Creative Commons identifiers.

rightsHolder.description: Rights holder names of individuals or organizations responsible for data ownership.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Prasinocyma semicrocea occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No information provided for type status.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is unavailable for all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when the record was last interpreted.

mediaType.description: Media type categorizes occurrence records by associated media format, such as still images.

issue.description: Data quality flags for occurrence records, e.g., coordinate rounding, continent derivation, missing taxon ID.
